comments.body:
Quest name: Crown of Aztec
Quest location: Amsterdam Adventurers' Guild
Skill requirement: r15 Search, r17 Appraisal, NWT(Nahuatl)
Pre-requisite discovery: Resplendent Quetzal discovery (from "God bird of rainbow colours" quest) + The Staff of Montezuma II discovery (from "Emperor of the Aztecs" quest)
Pre-requisite action: Treasure Hunter's Growth 1 skill must be activated in order to see the quest
